description: Source code for the AgentFieldClient class, which manages synchronous and asynchronous interactions with the AgentField API, including registration, execution, heartbeat, and management of async execution managers.

classes.name: _Submission
classes.description: Data class representing a submission with execution ID, run ID, target, status, and optional target type.

classes.name: AgentFieldClient
classes.description: Main client class for interacting with the AgentField API, supporting sync and async operations, registration, execution, heartbeat, and management functions.

methods.name: _generate_id
methods.description: Generates a unique ID with a prefix, timestamp, and random suffix.

methods.name: _build_event_stream_headers
methods.description: Builds headers to forward to SSE event stream, filtering allowed headers.

methods.name: _sanitize_header_values
methods.description: Ensures all header values are strings for HTTP requests.

methods.name: _get_auth_headers
methods.description: Returns authorization headers if API key is set.

methods.name: _get_headers_with_context
methods.description: Merges headers with active workflow context headers and auth headers.

methods.name: _maybe_update_event_stream_headers
methods.description: Updates stored SSE headers and propagates to async execution manager if enabled.

methods.name: discover_capabilities
methods.description: Queries the discovery API for capabilities with various filtering options.

methods.name: get_async_http_client
methods.description: Lazily creates and returns a shared httpx.AsyncClient for async HTTP requests.

methods.name: _async_request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request using the async client, with fallback to sync if needed.

methods.name: _init_shared_sync_session
methods.description: Initializes a shared requests.Session with retries and connection pooling.

methods.name: _get_sync_session
methods.description: Returns the shared sync session, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: _sync_request
methods.description: Performs a blocking HTTP request using the shared session, with detailed logging and checks for truncation.

methods.name: aclose
methods.description: Closes async HTTP client and execution manager resources.

methods.name: register_node
methods.description: Registers an agent node with the server.

methods.name: update_health
methods.description: Updates health status of a node.

methods.name: get_nodes
methods.description: Retrieves all registered nodes.

methods.name: _apply_vc_metadata
methods.description: Attaches VC metadata to registration data if provided.

methods.name: register_agent
methods.description: Registers or updates an agent asynchronously with detailed registration data.

methods.name: _get_async_execution_manager
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the async execution manager instance.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a reasoner or skill asynchronously, submitting and polling for result.

methods.name: execute_sync
methods.description: Blocking execution method for synchronous callers.

methods.name: _prepare_execution_headers
methods.description: Prepares headers for execution requests, including session and parent IDs.

methods.name: _submit_execution_sync
methods.description: Submits an execution request synchronously.

methods.name: _submit_execution_async
methods.description: Submits an execution request asynchronously.

methods.name: _parse_submission
methods.description: Parses response body into a _Submission object.

methods.name: _await_execution_sync
methods.description: Polls execution status synchronously until completion or timeout.

methods.name: _await_execution_async
methods.description: Polls execution status asynchronously until completion or timeout.

methods.name: _format_execution_result
methods.description: Formats the execution result and metadata.

methods.name: _build_execute_response
methods.description: Builds the final response object for execution results.

methods.name: _next_poll_interval
methods.description: Calculates the next polling interval with jitter.

methods.name: send_enhanced_heartbeat
methods.description: Sends an enhanced heartbeat asynchronously.

methods.name: send_enhanced_heartbeat_sync
methods.description: Sends an enhanced heartbeat synchronously.

methods.name: notify_graceful_shutdown
methods.description: Notifies server of graceful shutdown asynchronously.

methods.name: notify_graceful_shutdown_sync
methods.description: Notifies server of graceful shutdown synchronously.

methods.name: register_agent_with_status
methods.description: Registers an agent with immediate status reporting for fast lifecycle.

methods.name: _get_async_execution_manager
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the async execution manager instance.

methods.name: execute_async
methods.description: Submits an async execution request, with fallback to sync if needed.

methods.name: poll_execution_status
methods.description: Polls the status of a specific execution ID.

methods.name: batch_check_statuses
methods.description: Checks multiple execution statuses efficiently, with batch support.

methods.name: wait_for_execution_result
methods.description: Waits for an execution to complete and returns the result.

methods.name: cancel_async_execution
methods.description: Cancels an active async execution.

methods.name: list_async_executions
methods.description: Lists async executions with optional filtering.

methods.name: get_async_execution_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves metrics for async execution manager.

methods.name: cleanup_async_executions
methods.description: Cleans up completed async executions.

methods.name: close_async_execution_manager
methods.description: Closes the async execution manager and cleans up resources.
